name: Metro Transit NexTrip
tagline: Real-time departures and route data for Minneapolis–St. Paul transit
description: Public NexTrip API from Metro Transit serving Minneapolis–St. Paul. Provides real-time bus and train departure predictions, routes, directions, stops, and vehicle locations for the Twin Cities metropolitan area. Designed for transit apps, digital signage, and trip-planning tools.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Public free access; specific request quotas not published

use_cases: list Metro Transit routes for the Twin Cities
get real-time departures for a stop by stop ID
look up stops along a route and direction
get vehicle locations for a route
find nearby stops from lat/lon coordinates
